item.title: Morning Weather for Saturday, August 29
item.description: Good morning! It's the weekend. No school today! Here's your weather for Saturday, August 29. Saturday! No school and no hurry today. In Shanghai today, expect it to be drizzly. Temperatures will go up to 33 degrees, with a low of 27. There is a 100 percent chance of rain. Remember to take an umbrella with you! Rainy days are good for staying in. Maybe we can build a den with the blankets. And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be thundery with hail, with a high of 32 degrees. Here's a question: what is the best thing about today? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
